run_eval_selfplay: run the selfplay evaluation script to compute agreement rate, average score, and Pareto optimality from a log file
parse_log_selfplay: parse a selfplay log file to extract counts, values, and picks for both agents in each dialogue
compute_score_selection: compute the score of a selection by multiplying values with picks and summing the result
gen_choices_valid: generate all valid choices for object division given item counts for both agents
parse_line_debug: parse a single debug line from the selfplay log to extract context and choice information
